instruction: Enforce that all S3 buckets are encrypted
output: echo 'from pulumi_policy import PolicyPack, ResourceValidationPolicy; def validate(args, report): if args.resource_type == "aws:s3/bucket:Bucket" and not args.resource_properties.get("server_side_encryption_configuration"): report("Bucket must have encryption"); PolicyPack("s3-encryption", policies=[ResourceValidationPolicy(name="encrypt-s3", validate=validate)])' > policy.py
